Name: A Haley portrait mod - 1.6 update and full redraw
Author: Beesb
Description:
[center]Hi there!

I hyperfixated on Stardew since 1.6 launched, so I decided to rework this old thing I drew like, 6 years ago? lol
I made this mostly for fun, but if you use it feel free to let me know! I'd love to know if someone enjoys it ^^

You may post screenshots using this mod and video if you like, no visible credit necessary, but if someone asks, please direct them here! Thanks!

I don't post much art online anymore, but all my older art is somewhere in the links below!

These are just XNBs, so you can drop em in "C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits" and hit "replace", and the mod's installed!

Have a great one! Be kind to each other!

The flowery interface is from this lovely mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6166]here[/url]﻿!





[s]This is a Haley portrait mod! I'm real new to pixel art but I hope you like it! If you have any recommendations or things you want me to fix be sure to let me know.

Also this is my first time modding.... anything! Please be kind but please feel free to let me know what you'd like changed, if anything!


[b]Instructions:
[/b]This is a simple portrait mod! Find your Stardew Valley folder and just drag it into the portrait folder + replace the existing file for Haley with this one. Don't forget to make a backup of your game before adding any mods!! :)
